clock_note: The client clock ran about this many seconds behind the newest ledger closed_at during collection; the endpoint HTTP Date headers also varied by tens of seconds between pages. Collection timestamps above are client-clock values and are not used for interval computation. The chain timeline is anchored to closed_at.
notes: Records are stored newest first, exactly as returned by Horizon with order=desc.
Only closed ledgers are observable through this endpoint; no mempool or pending transaction data is included.
closed_at is second-granularity UTC ISO 8601, so close intervals are integer seconds.
This is a single collection window from a single vantage point; it is not a continuous monitor and not an SLA measurement.
